newsitem.title: CHINA: Yitai Coal to launch 166 mln B share IPO in July.
newsitem.headline: Yitai Coal to launch 166 mln B share IPO in July.

text.p: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co Ltd will make an initial public offering of 166 million B shares by the end of this month to be listed in Shanghai, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The offer will represent a price/earnings ratio of 10-12 times based on forecast 1997 net earnings of 120 million yuan under international accounting standards, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The company expects to soon receive the green light from the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the market regulator, to start the issue, the official said.
The company has named China Guotai Securities the domestic lead underwriter and Jardine Fleming International Inc as the global coordinator, the spokesman said.
Yitai plans to use the funds to mine coal and buy trains for transporting the coal, he said.
Based on international accounting standards, Yitai had net profits of 71.4 million yuan last year, 51.0 million yuan in 1995 and 28.0 million yuan the year before, the official.
Yitai expects coal output of more than four million tonnes for 1997, compared with three million last year tonnes, he said.

Based in Dongsheng city in the Inner Mongolia region of northern China where there are abundant coal resources, the firm supplies coal mainly to power stations and the smelting industry in eastern China.

After the B share issue, Yitai will have 366 million shares, comprising 200 million legal person shares -- equity held by institutions that is not publicly tradable under current rules -- and 166 million B shares.
